pocortx.settings.title: RTX Settings
pocortx.shader.title: Shader Settings
pocortx.rt.status.not_vulkan: switch the graphics API to Vulkan in Video Settings and restart the game
pocortx.rt.status.no_extension: the GPU driver has no ray query support
pocortx.rt.status.no_feature: the GPU does not support hardware ray tracing
pocortx.option.mode.tooltip: Hardware ray tracing: GPU ray queries through Vulkan.
pocortx.option.quality.tooltip: Trace resolution and rays per pixel. On a phone start with Medium.
pocortx.option.shadows.tooltip: Sun and moon shadows, including from things outside the screen.
pocortx.option.ao.tooltip: Soft shading in corners and under objects.
pocortx.option.gi.tooltip: Light bounced off lit surfaces and glowing blocks (one bounce).
pocortx.option.reflections.tooltip: Reflections on water, glass, ice, metal, polished stone and rain puddles.
pocortx.option.specular.tooltip: Sun glints on water and smooth surfaces.
pocortx.option.volumetric.tooltip: Sunbeams in the air (god rays) with real shadows.
pocortx.option.alpha_shadows.tooltip: Shadows through leaves and grass respect texture transparency. Turn off for more FPS.
pocortx.option.puddles.tooltip: Reflective puddles on exposed ground while it rains.
pocortx.option.waves.tooltip: Ripples on the water surface in reflections and highlights.
pocortx.option.denoise.tooltip: Accumulates frames and smooths ray tracing noise.
pocortx.option.debug.tooltip: Shows a single effect on its own.
pocortx.shader.enabled.tooltip: BSL-style colour grading, bloom, vignette and sharpening. Works on OpenGL and Vulkan.
pocortx.shader.tonemap.tooltip: Gently rolls off highlights, like cinematic shader packs.
pocortx.msg.failed: PocoRTX turned itself off: %s. Please send logs/latest.log, then /rtx on.
pocortx.msg.status: PocoRTX: %s | quality %s | distance %s | shadows %s | AO %s | GI %s | reflections %s | highlights %s | volumetric %s | shaders %s | sections %s, in scene %s
pocortx.msg.help: /rtx on|off, /rtx quality low|medium|high|ultra, /rtx distance 2-8, /rtx menu, /rtx shadermenu, /rtx shadows|ao|gi|reflections|specular|volumetric|puddles|waves|shaders true|false, /rtx debug ..., /rtx reset
